_header: Diego Venegas-Vargas | DAMIC-M collaboration | CCDarkSens Framework -- Walkthrough input: QEDark heavy-mediator rate tables (standard halo of Baxter et al., v_E = 253.7 km/s) for the five masses of walkthrough_quick_scan.json on a reduced cross-section axis (10^-42 to 10^-34 cm^2), written to data/qedark_rates/Si/heavy/walkthrough_vE253p7/.
_comment: Run: python3 utils/qedark_generate_grid.py configs/examples/qedark_generate_walkthrough.json. The five masses are points of the 800-point grid logspace(0.2, 1000, 800), so the same files exist in the long_scan_vE253p7 folder.
